info.title: Option Omega
info.description: OptionOmega backtests, portfolios and optimizations via its MCP server.

post.description: Starts a backtest and returns immediately with a runId. Then poll GetBacktestStatus. parameters is the complete strategy; the easiest way is to take the parameters object from GetSavedBacktest and change only what you need.

parameters.description: Complete strategy configuration (JSON); see parameters in GetSavedBacktest.

status.description: queued, running, complete, failed or cancelled.

pollAfterMs.description: Milliseconds until the next status call; absent in a final state.

default.description: Error from the tool or the MCP server

post.description: Automated strategies that the trading platform runs live in the brokerage account, sorted by name. GetAutomatedStrategy returns the full settings.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries per page, default 100, max. 500.

offset.description: Zero-based start position; pass nextOffset from the previous response.

linkedBacktestId.description: savedBacktestId of the backtest the strategy was created from; null if created from scratch. Not updated by later changes.

allocationAmount.description: Sizing value; meaning depends on allocationType.

accountName.description: Name of the brokerage account; null if the account was removed.

isActive.description: Strategy is running: opens new trades and manages open ones.

pauseNewTrades.description: New trades paused; open trades are still managed.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page; null on the last page.

default.description: Error from the tool or the MCP server

post.description: One automated strategy with its current live settings. Times in US Eastern market time, prices and premiums in dollars per share.

strategyId.description: Id of the automated strategy (from ListAutomatedStrategies).

description.description: Your own notes on the strategy.

linkedBacktestId.description: savedBacktestId of the backtest the strategy was created from; null if created from scratch. Not updated by later changes.

accountName.description: Name of the brokerage account; null if the account was removed.

isActive.description: Strategy is running: opens new trades and manages open ones.

pauseNewTrades.description: New trades paused; open trades are still managed.

allocation.description: Position size and max. open trades.

legGroups.description: Leg groups with profit, loss and exit rules.

execution.description: Order execution for entry and exit.

default.description: Error from the tool or the MCP server

post.description: Open trades of the automated strategies as shown on the app's live page. Values are approximations (updated about every minute during market hours, see lastUpdated). Rows are arrays; tradeColumns names the columns.

strategyIds.description: Only trades of these strategies (ids from ListAutomatedStrategies).

includeExitRules.description: Include exit rules per trade as columns legGroup and exitExecution (makes rows much larger).

offset.description: Zero-based start position; pass nextOffset from the previous response.

tradeColumns.description: Column names of the rows in trades.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page; null on the last page.

default.description: Error from the tool or the MCP server

post.description: Closed trades of the automated strategies by date of last close (US Eastern). Default: last 30 days, at most 90 days per call. Includes halted trades. Rows are arrays; tradeColumns names the columns.

closedFrom.description: First day, yyyy-MM-dd, inclusive; default 29 days before closedTo.

closedTo.description: Last day, yyyy-MM-dd, inclusive; default today.

strategyIds.description: Only trades of these strategies (ids from ListAutomatedStrategies).

outcome.description: winners or losers; omit for all.

reasonClosed.description: e.g. Profit Target or Stop Loss.

includeExitRules.description: Include exit rules per trade as columns legGroup and exitExecution (makes rows much larger).

offset.description: Zero-based start position; pass nextOffset from the previous response.

tradeColumns.description: Column names of the rows in trades.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page; null on the last page.

default.description: Error from the tool or the MCP server

post.description: Individual trades of a backtest or portfolio. Supply exactly one of the three ids. Rows are arrays; tradeColumns names the columns.

runId.description: Id of a run. Alternative to the other ids.

savedBacktestId.description: Id of a saved backtest. Alternative to the other ids.

savedPortfolioId.description: Id of a saved portfolio. Alternative to the other ids.

outcome.description: winners or losers; omit for all.

reasonClosed.description: e.g. Profit Target or Stop Loss.

strategyIds.description: Portfolio only: filter by strategy ids.

sortBy.description: opened (default), closed, profit, maxLoss or maxProfit.

offset.description: Zero-based start position; pass nextOffset from the previous response.

tradeColumns.description: Column names of the rows in trades.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page; null on the last page.

default.description: Error from the tool or the MCP server

post.description: Daily equity curve, at most two years per call. Supply exactly one of the three ids.

seriesEnd.description: Last day, yyyy-MM-dd; at most two years after seriesStart.

pointColumns.description: Column names of the rows in points.

default.description: Error from the tool or the MCP server
